names.note: Name page 11755 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Ираида, исповедница»; the rank is stripped and NOTHING ELSE IS LEFT — the calendar gives her no surname, no place and no epithet, on the line or on the name page, which is unusual for a twentieth-century entry and is the reason this form is bare. THE STRING IS NOT NEW: `fk.mjs` returns `raisa-of-alexandria`, which stores «Ираида» as the second of its two Russian forms for a virgin martyr of about 308 on the Julian 5 сентября, and the two-holder fold `ираида` is keyed in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit as this folder.

death.note: The day line closes «(1967)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 июля ст. ст. — «Св. Ираиды исп (1967).»

attestations.note: The day's last entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line is quoted exactly as the page prints it, «исп» without its abbreviation point, which is the page's own spelling and not a transcription slip. The line and name page agree: «исп.» and «исповедница», a confessor, so `confessor` is the whole of her `types`, and NO `office` IS WRITTEN — the calendar gives her no rank in the church at all, and nothing read says whether she was a nun or a laywoman. `new-martyr` was NOT written: she died in 1967 and the calendar calls her a confessor. THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held her: `ls -d saints/iraida*` is empty, and the only Cyrillic «Ираида» in the corpus is a name form on `raisa-of-alexandria`, a martyr of about 308. The day page prints no hymn under her name.
